create_internlm2_causal_lm: create an InternLM2ForCausalLM model with a PretrainedConfig and optional quantization config
build_decoder_layer: build an InternLM2DecoderLayer with config, layer id, quant config, and prefix for transformer block assembly
run_forward_pass: run a forward pass on InternLM2ForCausalLM with input_ids, positions, and forward_batch to get logits
load_model_weights: load weights into InternLM2ForCausalLM handling gate_up_proj stacking and wqkv splitting for q/k/v heads
build_attention_module: build an InternLM2Attention module with tensor-parallel head distribution, rope embedding, and radix attention
